prompt: I want desloppify set up so it automatically checks code quality on every commit. Set up the venv, run an initial scan, and configure the git hook so it scans before each commit.

assertions.text: A Python venv is created at .venv-desloppify/
desloppify is installed in the venv
A git pre-commit hook is created or configured that invokes desloppify
git config core.hooksPath is set to point at the hooks directory
The hook script activates the venv before running desloppify
